description: The plot illustrates the relationship between Average Lagging (AL) and BLEU scores for four distinct methods: Consistency-CE, Inconsistency-CE, Inconsistency-CE-MP, and Consistency-Bi. The x-axis is labeled "Average Lagging (AL)" and features a linear scale ranging from slightly below 0 to above 10, with numeric tick labels from 0.0 to 10.0 spaced at intervals of 2.5. The y-axis is labeled "BLEU" and utilizes a linear scale ranging from approximately 17.5 to 29.5, with numeric tick labels from 18 to 28 at intervals of 2, intersected by horizontal dashed grid lines. The "Consistency-CE" method is represented by a light purple dashed line with circular markers, starting at approximately x = 0.2, y = 18.8 and increasing to end at x = 3.0, y = 23.0. The "Inconsistency-CE" method is shown as a dark purple dashed line with square markers, beginning at x = 0.1, y = 20.1 and demonstrating a continuous upward trend to end at x = 9.9, y = 27.1. The "Inconsistency-CE-MP" method is depicted by a blue dashed line with square markers, starting at roughly x = -0.8, y = 18.5 and rising steadily to conclude at x = 9.8, y = 27.2. Finally, the "Consistency-Bi" method is illustrated by a red solid line with star markers; it begins at x = 0.8, y = 22.4, increases to a peak at x = 8.3, y = 28.8, and then slightly declines to finish at x = 10.5, y = 28.4.
